seo.metaTitle: Fabien Marié — Osteopath D.O in Talence and Mérignac, near Bordeaux
seo.metaDescription: Osteopath D.O in Gironde, France: a gentle, personalized approach for all ages — adults, pregnant women, infants. 2 clinics near Bordeaux: Talence and Mérignac. English spoken.

hero.heading: Rediscover Your Movement, Discover Your Dynamism
hero.subheading: A gentle and personalized approach, suited for all ages.

about.heading: About Fabien Marié
paragraphs: With nearly 20 years of practice, I master all osteopathic techniques. I also integrate complementary therapeutic approaches to offer you unique and personalized care tailored to your needs.
I treat your body as a whole for lasting healing. Having lived in England and the United States, I can offer you consultations in English.
about.quoteText: A professional of great kindness, very human and attentive. You immediately feel at ease in his expert hands.

forWhom.heading: For Whom ?
forWhom.subheading: I support you from 0 to 99 years old, from head to toe, to relieve, prevent and optimize your daily health.
forWhom.intro: Specialized in functional disorders, I treat of course back pain and radiating pain like sciatica, but also a wide range of disorders for all ages:
forWhom.footnote: 💡 Osteopathy is preventive medicine: the earlier we act, the better!

cards.title: Sports Osteopathy
cards.body: Prevention and treatment of sports injuries to optimize performance and comfort during activity.

cards.title: Newborns
cards.body: Treatment of functional disorders in infants (colic, torticollis, plagiocephaly, etc.) to restore their mobility and comfort.

cards.title: Pediatrics
cards.body: Management of functional disorders in children (postural, digestive, sequelae of falls, sleep disorders, etc.) for harmonious and comfortable growth.

cards.title: Psychosomatic Approach
cards.body: A personalized approach to osteopathy that I can combine with sophrology, hypnosis or relaxation techniques according to your needs.
